text: The athletics event at the 2008 Summer Olympics with the highest number of competitors was the Men's 400 metres, which had 55 competitors from 40 nations [doc1::3]. The Men's hammer throw had 33 competitors [doc1::5], and the Women's 200 metres had 46 competitors [doc1::7]. Therefore, the Men's 400 metres is confirmed as having the highest number of competitors.
